Question
========
What is self-plagiarism?

Answerlist
----------
* utilizing data that has already been used for another research to test new hypotheses
* reusing own work without acknowledgment
* having author's original work claimed by others as theirs
* sourcing author's own previous publications


Solution
========
Self-plagiarism is reusing own work without acknowledgment.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
